positions.title: Solutions Engineer
positions.description:
- Designed and validated API integrations between SaaS platforms and client systems, ensuring reliable authentication, payload mapping, and data exchange.

- Architected integration workflows that translated complex government and business requirements into scalable platform configurations.

- Performed end-to-end QA, troubleshooting, and issue resolution across integrations, maintaining compliance and delivery quality in a fast-paced startup environment.

positions.title: Software Engineer (Cancelled Federal Contract)
positions.description:
- Optimized AWS infrastructure supporting the USAID R-LEAD program, achieving 99.9% uptime while maintaining full ATO security compliance.

- Built CI/CD pipelines using Bitbucket, Docker, Kubernetes, and Terraform, reducing deployment friction and improving release reliability.

- Served as a technical escalation point for cloud, DNS, and identity-related incidents, restoring services while preserving compliance requirements.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Designed, deployed, and supported secure, high-traffic government web platforms, including the U.S. House of Representatives, meeting accessibility and regulatory standards.

- Provided post-sales solutions engineering and Tier 2/3 technical support, diagnosing production issues and performing root cause analysis under SLA constraints.

- Automated database migrations and ETL workflows using Python and SQL, reducing manual data operations by 50%+ and improving data reliability.

positions.title: Web Developer / Support Engineer
positions.locationName: Washington, District of Columbia, United States
positions.description:
-Designed, deployed, and managed secure, responsive websites for government clients, including the House of Representatives, ensuring full regulatory compliance while leading web project management efforts to coordinate development, deployment, and client requirements for optimized performance, accessibility, and user experience.

- Automated database migrations, exports, and ETL processes using Python and SQL scripts, improving data reliability and operational efficiency for CRM applications.

- Provided technical solutions and post-sales support, configuring CRM workflows, troubleshooting issues, and optimizing web platforms to enhance client success.

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
- Built and maintained custom WordPress, BigCommerce, and Shopify themes and templates, delivering brand-specific, responsive storefronts across multiple client sites.

- Improved front-end performance and API-driven interactions by optimizing custom theme components, reducing page load times and production issues across e-commerce platforms.

- Designed scalable MongoDB schemas and integrated custom forms and APIs to support product catalogs and customer data workflows for high-traffic sites.

company.name: Second Harvest Food Bank of Orange County

positions.title: Food Sourcing Account Manager / Analyst
positions.description:
- Increased food safety compliance, knowledge of program guidelines, and cooperation among all stakeholders involved which resulted in increased rescued food donation pounds.

- Implemented a data driven approach to evaluate food rescue trends, departmental capacity to meet the organizational demand, and to optimize efficiency and quality of service.

- Generated donor reports to communicate to local, regional, and corporate stakeholders to reduce their organic waste and to meet the sustainability requirements set by State legislation.

- Evaluated food safety policies and processes to recommend changes to improve productivity and reduce expenses and/or enhance customer service.

positions.title: Volunteerism Project Coordinator
positions.description:
- Built and maintained key volunteer relationships with corporate and community organizations.

- Integrated and updated the volunteer database management system to streamline registration and to efficiently provide information to volunteers.

- Managed and directed a team of 115 volunteers to pack produce for timely distribution while ensuring a safe and positive experience.

positions.title: Housing Navigator
positions.description:
- Determined eligibility and entered client assessments into a government central entry system for prioritization and coordination for housing.

- Provided comprehensive case management, document maintenance and supportive services, including developing a specific housing plan.

- Collaborated with Department of Housing Services to secure housing resources, referrals and linkages for social services to families and individuals.

positions.title: Volunteerism Project Coordinator
positions.description:
- Planned and executed all orientation programs and training for incoming volunteers.

- Advocated the use of community resources and solicited community participation to provide services to families dealing with homelessness.

- Reviewed written reports and logged volunteer hours.
